title: QuickRN Webmaster Question Review Register
scope: All recovered question-specific reviews from prior QuickRN conversations

changes: Decode HTML entities and remove markup from learner-facing prompt fields before rendering.
Normalize legacy clinical scenario text into the standardized clinical record without creating a separate Clinical scenario tab.
Suppress duplicate patient-information sections and duplicate clinical tab content while retaining distinct EHR sections.
Expose per-item structural validation and whole-bank duplicate-ID/quality audit APIs.
Keep original IDs, answer keys, item formats, and scoring metadata unchanged during presentation normalization.
bankWideImplementation.validation: JavaScript syntax checked; automated Node test execution and browser/runtime validation still required.

reviews.finding: Matrix/grid left pane displayed raw caseGroupId, patientProfile, and tabs metadata; clinical scenario was missing and correct/incorrect row feedback was absent.
reviews.implementation: Shared renderer now normalizes legacy clinical data and exposes matrix structural checks. Exact source record was not located in the active script set by this pass.

reviews.finding: Move the pregnant-client scenario to the left clinical pane; remove empty caseGroupId, patientProfile, and tabs metadata from the learner view; preserve question format and scoring.
reviews.implementation: Shared renderer migrates legacy scenario text into Nurses’ Notes and suppresses raw metadata from learner-facing output.

reviews.finding: Move PPE-removal sequence context/stem to the left pane; retain ordered drag-and-drop response, sequence, and scoring.
reviews.implementation: Global clinical prompt split/normalization applies at render time; ordered response format and scoring are not rewritten.

reviews.finding: Remove duplicate patient information and HTML; provide a detailed alcohol-withdrawal rationale; retain Bowtie choices and partial-credit scoring; correct/incorrect feedback must be visible.
reviews.implementation: Current batch-004 record contains a Bowtie condition, two keyed actions, two keyed monitoring parameters, and a detailed withdrawal/CIWA-Ar rationale. Shared renderer now strips markup and deduplicates clinical sections. Scoring implementation was not modified.

reviews.finding: Historical review described missing Bowtie monitoring parameters.
reviews.implementation: Current mapped record is Dropdown Rationale, not Bowtie, and contains diagnosis/action/reason dropdowns. This is an identifier/format conflict; do not convert it to Bowtie without resolving which source item the review referred to.

reviews.finding: Patient information was rendered as raw HTML/text and duplicated.
reviews.implementation: Current mapped record contains patient context and EHR fields; global renderer sanitizes markup and suppresses duplicate clinical sections.

reviews.finding: Thyroid case patient information was HTML-encoded.
reviews.implementation: Prompt and clinical-field normalization now decodes entities and strips markup before display.

reviews.finding: No clinical information or case was shown.
reviews.implementation: Current mapped record includes patient age/history, EHR assessment/priority concern, complete Bowtie condition/action/monitoring options and answer key. Shared renderer normalization applies.

reviews.finding: Historical review reported no clinical data and no selectable responses.
reviews.implementation: Current mapped supplement record contains patient history, vital signs, assessment, priority concern, five options, and two correct selections. Shared renderer validation will flag missing options/keys in future records.

reviews.finding: Matrix response feedback did not show correct/incorrect results.
reviews.implementation: Shared renderer contains row-level matrix correctness feedback and the new audit flags incomplete matrix structure. Specific runtime grading remains to be tested.

reviews.finding: Clinical information used inconsistent bold and regular font styling.
reviews.implementation: Clinical record content is normalized to plain text and rendered through consistent shared EHR typography.
New Bowtie structural audit checks for condition, actions, monitoring options, and keyed monitoring answers. Source record must be verified before content changes.
New bank audit reports clinical-context gaps where structured case metadata exists without usable clinical content. Missing clinical details will not be fabricated.

Current mapped item is a DKA cloze plan with explicit clinical stem, potassium/glucose/ketone data, three dropdowns, keyed answers, and rationale. Keep cloze format; review wording for clarity during webmaster content review.

releaseNote: This register preserves every recovered review and distinguishes global presentation fixes from item-specific content or scoring checks. No question is marked personally reviewed until the webmaster checks its clinical content, answer key, and rationale.

findings: All 50 batch-004 Trend records are held because their time-series rows contain intervention statements rather than serial clinical measurements.
The first 10 case groups received 90 new case-specific rationales and targeted answer-key repairs; one pre-existing detailed QR-002150 rationale was preserved.
359 remaining non-Trend batch-004 records still require item-specific rationales and review.
No clinical measurements or rationales were fabricated for the held Trend items.
